entity.summary: Self-custodial cryptocurrency wallet ecosystem distributed through mobile applications and a browser extension by Backpack.
entity.notes: Current first-party Backpack support explicitly describes Backpack Wallet as self-custodial, states private keys never leave the user device, and confirms mobile/browser distribution. Initial launch date remains unresolved.

products.summary: Current self-custodial Backpack browser extension for wallet and dApp use on supported desktop browsers.
products.notes: Selected browser-extension boundary only; mobile is deferred. Current first-party wallet support explicitly describes Backpack as self-custodial, while the official download page establishes Chrome, Brave and Edge distribution. Original extension launch remains unresolved.

events.title: Backpack 0.10.1-latest-4 released
events.description: The official Backpack repository published the 0.10.1-latest-4 release with a packaged extension build, providing a dated product-release checkpoint for the browser-wallet lineage.

evidence.title: What is Backpack Wallet?
evidence.notes: Current first-party Backpack support explicitly describes Backpack as a self-custodial crypto wallet and links browser, iOS and Android distribution.

evidence.title: Backpack Browser Extension
evidence.notes: Same first-party download authority specifically lists Backpack Browser Extension for Chrome, Brave and Edge. Kept as one source URL because a second custody source has not yet been established; candidate remains researching.

evidence.title: Download Backpack
evidence.notes: Current first-party Backpack download page distributes the browser extension for Chrome, Brave and Edge, supporting an actively maintained extension product.

evidence.title: Backpack 0.10.1-latest-4
evidence.notes: Official Backpack GitHub release published 2023-12-25 with extension build asset.
